diagram_math_checks.check: f is entire and f(gamma(t))=exp(2it) has modulus 1; both contours close at 1 and the image trace avoids 0. This verifies the item Statement and proof step 1.1 interface in this concrete example.

diagram_math_checks.geometry_and_orientation: Both drawn circles have radius 1 about the marked origin. Increasing t gives arguments t and 2t, hence positive counterclockwise orientation, with respectively one and two traversals. The arc arrows run from polar angle 20 to 80 degrees, so both point counterclockwise.
diagram_math_checks.check: Multiplicity is explicitly in labels and caption; a single geometric circle is not presented as recording multiplicity. Origin is inside each circle but not on either trace.

diagram_math_checks.check: theta(t)=2t has increment 4pi, so local L2 gives index 2. Here f′/f=2/z on the source circle; parametrizing dz=i exp(it)dt gives integral 4pi i. This directly checks the equality displayed in the item and step 3.1; no zeros/poles count or unpictured generality is inferred.
